rationale: Both Shant and Jessie are LA-based technologists working at the intersection of specialized technical problems—Shant in freight fraud prevention and carrier verification, Jessie in computer vision and motion tracking. While their domains differ, Shant's fraud-prevention platform could benefit from advanced technical talent to expand its detection capabilities, and Jessie's background in building complex vision and tracking systems represents the kind of technical depth that could strengthen verification and identity systems.
intro_message: Shant Lokmanian, meet Jessie Jia — you're both LA-based engineers tackling technically complex problems, and Jessie's expertise in computer vision and motion tracking could be relevant to the verification and fraud-prevention challenges Shant is solving at Fenderr Freight.
